meaning.en: to be tense and alert, as if something is about to happen
meaning.tr: her an bir şey olacakmış gibi gergin ve tetikte olmak
meaning.de: angespannt und wachsam sein, als würde gleich etwas passieren

equivalent.de: angespannt sein, wie auf heißen Kohlen sitzen

literal.en: to be standing at the edge

usage.en: be/feel/seem on edge · put/set sb on edge (cause). The adjective "edgy" means "tense" in BrE but mostly "unconventional, daring (style)" in AmE.
usage.tr: be/feel/seem on edge · put/set sb on edge (sebep). "edgy" sıfatı BrE'de "gergin", AmE'de çoğunlukla "sıra dışı, cesur (tarz)" demektir.

collocations.en: a bit on edge · on edge all day
collocations.tr: a bit on edge · on edge all day

sentences.en: I've been [on edge] all week waiting for the results.
sentences.tr: Sonuçları beklerken bütün hafta diken üstündeydim.
sentences.de: Ich bin die ganze Woche angespannt, weil ich auf die Ergebnisse warte.

sentences.en: Everyone at work is [on edge] since the layoffs were announced.
sentences.tr: İşten çıkarmalar duyurulduğundan beri iş yerinde herkes gergin.
sentences.de: Seit die Entlassungen angekündigt wurden, sind bei der Arbeit alle nervös.

meaning.en: to feel under pressure and unable to cope calmly
meaning.de: sich unter Druck fühlen und nicht ruhig bleiben können

usage.en: be/get stressed (out) (about/over sth) → the one who feels it. stress sb out → the cause. stress (about sth) → verb: "Stop stressing." stressful = CAUSING stress (a situation, a job).
usage.tr: be/get stressed (out) (about/over sth) → hisseden. stress sb out → sebep. stress (about sth) → fiil: "Stop stressing." stressful = stres VEREN (durum, iş).

collocations.en: so stressed out · stress over nothing
collocations.tr: so stressed out · stress over nothing

sentences.en: I'm so [stressed out] about finals.
sentences.de: Ich bin so gestresst wegen der Abschlussprüfungen.

sentences.en: You're [stressing me out] — can you stop pacing?
sentences.tr: Beni geriyorsun, volta atmayı keser misin?
sentences.de: Du stresst mich – kannst du aufhören, hin und her zu laufen?

meaning.en: to be tense or jittery because of something that is going to happen
meaning.tr: olacak bir şey yüzünden gergin/heyecanlı olmak
meaning.de: wegen etwas Bevorstehendem angespannt oder zittrig sein

equivalent.tr: gergin olmak, heyecanlanmak, eli ayağına dolaşmak

usage.en: nervous about + noun/V-ing · make sb nervous
usage.tr: nervous about + isim/V-ing · make sb nervous

note.en: False friend! "nervous" is not Turkish "sinirli" (angry). Jitters before an exam = nervous; "sinirli" = angry/annoyed.
note.tr: Sahte dost! "nervous" Türkçedeki "sinirli" (öfkeli) değildir. Sınav öncesi heyecan = nervous; sinirli = angry/annoyed.

sentences.en: I'm really [nervous about] the presentation tomorrow.
sentences.de: Ich bin wirklich nervös wegen der Präsentation morgen.

sentences.en: Stop staring at me, you're making me [nervous].
sentences.de: Hör auf, mich anzustarren, du machst mich nervös.

meaning.en: to be in a terrible state from anxiety
meaning.de: vor Angst in einem furchtbaren Zustand sein

equivalent.tr: sinirleri harap olmak, kaygıdan perişan olmak
equivalent.de: ein Nervenbündel sein, mit den Nerven am Ende sein

usage.en: be a (complete/total) nervous wreck. Related: "I'm a wreck." (I'm physically/emotionally in pieces.)
usage.tr: be a (complete/total) nervous wreck. İlgili: "I'm a wreck." (fiziksel/duygusal olarak dağılmış hâldeyim)

sentences.en: I was [a nervous wreck] before my driving test.
sentences.de: Vor meiner Fahrprüfung war ich ein Nervenbündel.

sentences.en: By the time the results came out, she was a complete [nervous wreck].
sentences.tr: Sonuçlar açıklanana kadar sinirleri harap oldu.
sentences.de: Als die Ergebnisse kamen, war sie mit den Nerven völlig am Ende.

meaning.en: to feel a flutter in your stomach from excitement (often a pleasant kind)
meaning.tr: heyecandan midede kıpırtı hissetmek (çoğu zaman tatlı bir heyecan)
meaning.de: vor Aufregung ein Kribbeln im Bauch spüren (oft angenehm)

equivalent.tr: midesinde kelebekler uçuşmak, içi kıpır kıpır olmak
equivalent.de: Schmetterlinge im Bauch haben, Lampenfieber haben

literal.en: to have butterflies in your stomach

sentences.en: I [had butterflies] before going on stage.
sentences.tr: Sahneye çıkmadan önce içim kıpır kıpırdı.
sentences.de: Ich hatte Lampenfieber, bevor ich auf die Bühne ging.

sentences.en: I still [get butterflies] every time I see him.
sentences.tr: Onu her gördüğümde hâlâ midemde kelebekler uçuşuyor.
sentences.de: Ich bekomme immer noch Schmetterlinge im Bauch, wenn ich ihn sehe.

meaning.en: to be extremely worried (usually about someone)
meaning.de: sich extrem große Sorgen machen (meist um jemanden)

equivalent.de: krank vor Sorge sein, sich furchtbare Sorgen machen

literal.en: so worried that you are ill

usage.en: be worried sick (about sb/sth). Basic patterns: worried about (not "worried for" in most cases) · worry sb · worrying = causing worry.
usage.tr: be worried sick (about sb/sth). Temel kalıplar: worried about (✗ worried for değil, çoğu durumda) · worry sb · worrying = endişe verici.

sentences.en: Where have you been? I was [worried sick]!
sentences.de: Wo warst du? Ich war krank vor Sorge!

sentences.en: She's [worried sick] about her mom's surgery.
sentences.de: Sie macht sich furchtbare Sorgen wegen der Operation ihrer Mutter.

meaning.en: to be too tense, rigid, unable to relax
meaning.tr: fazla gergin, katı, rahat olamayan biri olmak
meaning.de: zu angespannt und steif sein, nicht locker lassen können

usage.en: be/get uptight (about sth). Used both for a passing state and for personality.
usage.tr: be/get uptight (about sth). Geçici hâl için de kişilik için de kullanılır.

sentences.en: Don't be so [uptight] — it's just a game.
sentences.tr: Bu kadar kasma, alt tarafı oyun.
sentences.de: Sei nicht so verkrampft – es ist nur ein Spiel.

sentences.en: He gets really [uptight] about money.
sentences.de: Beim Thema Geld wird er richtig verkrampft.

meaning.en: to think about something far more than necessary and blow it up
meaning.tr: bir şeyi gereğinden fazla düşünüp büyütmek
meaning.de: über etwas viel mehr nachdenken als nötig und es aufbauschen

equivalent.de: zu viel nachdenken, sich den Kopf zerbrechen

usage.en: overthink sth / overthink it · "You're overthinking it/this." · an overthinker
usage.tr: overthink sth / overthink it · "You're overthinking it/this." · an overthinker

sentences.en: Just send the text — you're [overthinking] it.
sentences.de: Schick die Nachricht einfach ab – du denkst zu viel darüber nach.

sentences.en: I tend to [overthink] everything people say to me.
sentences.tr: İnsanların bana söylediği her şeyi kafamda kurma huyum var.
sentences.de: Ich neige dazu, alles zu zerdenken, was Leute zu mir sagen.

meaning.en: to feel very reluctant and anxious about something that is coming
meaning.tr: yaklaşan bir şeyden çok çekinmek, onu hiç istememek
meaning.de: etwas Bevorstehendem mit großem Widerwillen und Angst entgegensehen

equivalent.tr: gözü korkmak, içi hiç istememek, ödü kopmak
equivalent.de: sich vor etwas fürchten, jemandem graut vor etwas

usage.en: dread + noun / V-ing. Very common in the continuous: "I'm dreading it."
usage.tr: dread + isim / V-ing. Sürekli zamanla çok yaygın: "I'm dreading it."

sentences.en: I'm [dreading] Monday's meeting.
sentences.de: Mir graut vor dem Meeting am Montag.

sentences.en: I'm [dreading] telling my parents I failed.
sentences.de: Mir graut davor, meinen Eltern zu sagen, dass ich durchgefallen bin.

meaning.en: (of pressure, criticism, stress) to gradually start affecting and wearing someone down
meaning.tr: (baskı, eleştiri, stres) zamanla birini etkilemeye, yıpratmaya başlamak
meaning.de: (von Druck, Kritik, Stress) jemandem allmählich zusetzen

equivalent.de: jemandem zusetzen, an jemandem nagen, jemandem nahegehen

usage.en: sth gets to sb (subject = the cause). "Don't let it get to you." · "It's starting to get to me."
usage.tr: sth gets to sb (özne = sebep). "Don't let it get to you." · "It's starting to get to me."

sentences.en: The pressure is really starting to [get to me].
sentences.de: Der Druck setzt mir langsam wirklich zu.

sentences.en: Don't let his comments [get to you].
sentences.de: Lass seine Kommentare nicht an dich ran.
